Hero.title: Turn your digital presence into a tool that works for your business
Hero.description: Seekursor designs websites, customer experiences and digital tools to help businesses present themselves clearly, serve their customers better and work more effectively.
Hero.baseline: Based in Haiti · Built for businesses · Open to other markets

Discovery.title: Before contacting you, your customer is already trying to understand three things

items.title: Find you
items.description: Your business should be easy to discover when a customer starts looking.

items.title: Understand you
items.description: Your offering, services and essential information should be easy to grasp.

items.title: Take action
items.description: The path to getting in touch, making an inquiry, booking or ordering should be clear.

Services.title: The right level of solution for the right need
Services.description: We start with what your business wants to improve, rather than a predetermined technology or format.

items.title: Digital presence
items.subtitle: Present your business and what it offers clearly.
items.description: Websites, presentation pages, menus, catalogues and other online touchpoints designed to make your business clearer and more accessible.

items.title: Customer experience
items.subtitle: Make customer journeys simpler.
items.description: Experiences designed to make it easier to find information, get in touch, book, inquire or order.

items.title: Digital tools
items.subtitle: Create the tools your business actually needs.
items.description: Web applications, internal tools, portals and interfaces adapted to the way you work.

items.title: Automation
items.subtitle: Reduce repetitive tasks that slow your business down.
items.description: Better-connected processes to simplify everyday work and reduce unnecessary manual steps.

Services.aiNote: AI can be part of a solution when it brings real value. It is not the default.

Process.title: Understand first. Build next
Process.description: A good solution starts with the problem it needs to solve, rather than the technology used to build it.

items.title: Understand
items.description: Your business, your customers and what you want to improve.

items.title: Identify
items.description: The real challenges and the priority worth addressing.

items.title: Design
items.description: A clear response, with a prototype when it helps you decide.

items.title: Build
items.description: A tested, refined solution that can evolve with your business.

Projects.title: See an idea take shape
Projects.description: A few demonstrations of what a digital solution can bring to a real business setting.

items.title: A restaurant that is easier to discover
items.description: Menu, opening hours, location and contact details brought together in a clear mobile experience.
items.longDescription: An example of a digital presence for a restaurant, designed to help customers find useful information before visiting or getting in touch.

items.title: A business that is easier to understand
items.description: A structured presentation of the offering that answers initial questions before the first conversation.
items.longDescription: An example website for a service business, designed to clarify its offering and help visitors prepare for their first conversation.

items.title: A catalogue that is easier to browse
items.description: A clearer way to explore products and prepare an inquiry.
items.longDescription: A digital catalogue demonstration for a shop, designed to help customers explore products and make a clear inquiry.

Differentiation.title: Why Seekursor

items.title: Start with the need
items.description: We begin by understanding what is genuinely worth improving.

items.title: Build what is useful
items.description: Every element should serve a clear purpose for your business or your customers.

items.title: Keep things simple
items.description: A useful solution should remain understandable to the people who will use it.

items.title: Consider the context
items.description: We build from Haiti, paying close attention to the habits, constraints and realities of the local market.

Differentiation.closing: Our ambition extends beyond Haiti. Our approach stays the same: understand before building.

Founder.title: A direct conversation with the founder
Founder.imageAlt: Harly Thelusma, founder of Seekursor, at work
Founder.statement1: Harly Thelusma founded Seekursor with a simple conviction: a good digital solution begins with a good understanding of the business.
Founder.statement2: Based in Haiti, he works directly with businesses to turn a concrete need into a useful solution.

FinalCTA.title: Have something to improve? Let’s talk
FinalCTA.description: Tell us what you want to improve, what costs you time or what you would like to make simpler. We will start by understanding before proposing anything.
